WITH date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
),
web_sales_by_day AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
           dr.d_date,
           SUM(ws.ws_sales_price) AS daily_sales
    FROM date_range dr
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, dr.d_date
),
store_sales_by_day AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
           dr.d_date,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS daily_sales
    FROM date_range dr
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, dr.d_date
),
web_running AS (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(daily_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cume_sales
    FROM web_sales_by_day
),
store_running AS (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(daily_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cume_sales
    FROM store_sales_by_day
),
joined AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.item_sk, s.item_sk) AS item_sk,
           COALESCE(w.d_date, s.d_date) AS d_date,
           w.cume_sales AS web_sales,
           s.cume_sales AS store_sales
    FROM web_running w
    FULL OUTER JOIN store_running s
        ON w.item_sk = s.item_sk
        AND w.d_date = s.d_date
),
running_totals AS (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           web_sales,
           store_sales,
           MAX(web_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS web_cumulative,
           MAX(store_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS store_cumulative
    FROM joined
)
SELECT item_sk,
       d_date,
       web_sales,
       store_sales,
       web_cumulative,
       store_cumulative
FROM running_totals
WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
